summary.text: Chris Humphrey is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 12 who has served since January 1, 2019, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as independent insurance agency owner and his district as Greene, Jones and Lenoir counties.

paragraphs.text: Humphrey assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2019, succeeding Democrat George Graham, according to Ballotpedia.
The Republican primary for his seat in March 2026 was canceled, and his general election opponent is Democrat Don Hardy.
Humphrey chairs the House Insurance Committee and is vice chairman of the Health Committee and of the Appropriations Subcommittee on Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources.
He also serves on the House Agriculture and Environment, Appropriations, and Emergency Management and Disaster Recovery committees and the House Select Committee on Redistricting.
